method: Independent source and adversarial-test inspection, followed by commit/blob/source and retained producer-log hash verification.
independently_found_and_resolved: Interrupted publication could retain a visible admission while its descriptor was closed; transaction rollback and actual-owner disposal now cover five injected mutation seams.
Driver metadata/identity construction could lose a newly pinned descriptor before ownership transfer; preallocated release owner now covers successful and uncertain disposal.
Unbounded compiler read could allocate from oversized files or hang on a FIFO; initial and reuse identity use the established stable bounded nonblocking reader.
additional_reviewed_boundaries: Parent dependency and outstanding lease retention during retirement and actual child execution.
Sealed descriptors survive publication-path replacement; trusted driver checks loaded symbol mapping.
Separate uncertain read and failed-memfd closes stay charged, consume finite admission budget, and are never numerically retried.
Release-complete receipt requires no active entries/debt/leases/reservations/charges and a complete driver release.

retained_failed_attempt.reason: Development fault instrumentation captured a publication read FD before pinning; the numeric FD was reused by compiler temporary-directory cleanup. Injection was restricted to the real pin operation before the frozen successful run.

review_result: The three confirmed implementation findings are closed within the examined research boundary; no additional release/admission authority widening was found in this inspection.
